question: Z1 and Z2 together complete a work in 15 days. Z2 alone can complete the same work in 30 days. They took Rs. 2000 to complete the work together. What will be the share of Z1?
solution:
Given: 

Z1 and Z2 together complete a work in 15 days.

Z2 alone can complete the same work in 30 days.

They took Rs. 2000 to complete the work together.

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

The efficiency of a person is inversely proportional to the number of days to complete the work.

Calculation:

Let total work is 30 units ( Lcm of 30 and 15)

The efficiency of Z1 + Z2 is

⇒ 30 / 15 = 2 unit

The efficiency of Z1 + Z2 is

⇒ 30 / 30 = 1 unit

The efficiency of Z2 is 2 - 1 = 1 unit

Their efficiency is same .

Money received by Z1 is 2000 / 2 = Rs 1000

**∴ The correct option is** **3**
